query: INSERT INTO fnr_client_policies (client_id, created_at, signers, max_duration_ms, max_concurrency, max_wasm_memory_mb, max_db_pool_size, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE SET signers = EXCLUDED.signers, max_duration_ms = EXCLUDED.max_duration_ms, max_concurrency = EXCLUDED.max_concurrency, max_wasm_memory_mb = EXCLUDED.max_wasm_memory_mb, max_db_pool_size = EXCLUDED.max_db_pool_size, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
